title: Users
summary: The people who can sign in: list, search, add, edit, deactivate; each person's own profile page; first-user bootstrap from env. Offers UserClient (incl. SetPassword for an auth provider); every change audited; guarded by users.read / users.manage.
when_to_use: Any app where people sign in with an account the app itself stores.
when_not_to_use: Sign-in through an external identity provider only (SSO/OAuth) with no local accounts.

env.name: USERS_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL
env.description: With USERS_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD: creates this first user when the users table is empty.

env.name: USERS_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD
env.description: Password of the bootstrap user (at least 8 characters). Remove both after the first sign-in.

env.name: USERS_BOOTSTRAP_NAME
env.description: Name of the bootstrap user (default: Administrator).
